messages.text: Still on for the Bear Creek hike Saturday? I can drive. My car fits four.
Yes! But the weather app says rain after 1 P.M. Can we start earlier than 10?
Sure. How about leaving at 7:30? The trail takes about four hours round-trip.
Ugh, that's early, but fine. I'll bring sandwiches for everyone.
Perfect. My cousin Tom is visiting this weekend and wants to come too. Is that OK?
Of course. That makes four, so we're all set. I'll pick everyone up at Lucy's place.
Don't forget your rain jackets, just in case! And wear good shoes, since that trail gets muddy.

questions.stem: Why does Lucy want to start the hike earlier?
options: A. To eat lunch at the trail
B. To pick up her cousin
D. To return before Kenji's work
questions.explanation: Lucy says, "the weather app says rain after 1 P.M. Can we start earlier than 10?"

questions.stem: At 7:17 P.M., what does Priya mean when she writes, "Ugh, that's early, but fine"?
options: A. She will not join the hike.
B. She would like to drive instead.
C. She thinks the trail is too long.
D. She agrees to a time she does not love.
questions.explanation: "Ugh, that's early" shows she dislikes the 7:30 start, but "fine" shows she accepts it.

questions.stem: What is suggested about Kenji's car?
options: A. It will be full on Saturday.
B. It will need to make two trips.
C. It is parked at Lucy's place.
D. It cannot be used in the rain.
questions.explanation: Kenji says "My car fits four," and with Tom joining, "That makes four."
